current.long_term_thesis: VXUS provides broad diversification across developed and emerging international markets, offering essential geographic balance to a U.S.-heavy portfolio. Over the long term, international exposure can reduce concentration risk and capture growth cycles when non-U.S. markets outperform.
current.risks: The primary risks are U.S. dollar strength (which erodes international returns when converted back to USD), geopolitical instability in emerging markets, and valuation sensitivity to global interest rate cycles. Trading near 52-week highs also leaves limited near-term upside buffer if sentiment shifts.
